name: Disk space
description: How much room is left on this machine's disks, counted per disk rather than per mount.
author: uDeck

settings.label: Warn above
settings.help: How full a disk has to be, in percent, before the card turns amber.

settings.label: Critical above
settings.help: How full a disk has to be before the card turns red. A value below the warning threshold is raised to it.

settings.label: What to list
settings.help: A modern Mac splits its startup disk into several volumes that share one pool of free space. Listing them separately shows the same free space five times over.

settings.label: Hide the system's own volumes
settings.help: Preboot, Recovery and the rest. A disk that holds nothing else disappears with them; a disk that also holds your files still counts them, because they take real space on it.

settings.label: Path to keep an eye on
settings.help: The disk holding this path is always listed, and listed first. Empty means no preference.
